title: knowledge: 3 FP-suppression guards from BC apps negative feedback
summary: Three knowledge articles are added to clarify AL facts that were incorrectly flagged by the review agent, suppressing false-positive findings for ObsoleteReason omissions, bare Get() calls, and OnAfterGetCurrRecord behavior.
key_points: ObsoleteTag carries removal version; ObsoleteReason need not restate it
Bare Rec.Get() raises an error when record is missing, not silently ignored
OnAfterGetCurrRecord fires on current-record change, not per row; CalcFields there is not N+1
Articles follow existing negative-clarification style with false-positive keyword
Knowledge index grows from 245 to 248 entries
quote: Each encodes an AL fact that the review agent got wrong, so the corresponding finding is suppressed going forward.
